ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; visible surface area consists of approximately 60 percent high-intensity white pixels and 40 percent low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes. Left lobe white field is concentrated towards the inner margin. Right lobe white field covers approximately 75 percent of the surface area. Black pigmentation defines the leading edges and the central fluke join (peduncle area).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude peaks. Significant high-amplitude geometric irregularities are present at the distal tips due to external attachments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast circular clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips, causing irregular distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, distinct low-intensity focal spot (black dot) is present in the lower central region of the right lobe white field.
